predictions.N1: （主）S-RRR_nat 的单向 plus R_2N（每个骨干）。H-natural：≥ 0.90；对立：≤ 0.50。
predictions.N2: （主）S-RRR_syn 零样本的单向 R_2N。H-transfer：≥ 0.80；H-no-transfer：≤ 0.30。dev 上已 ≥ 0.95 或 ≤ 0.05 时降为描述性。
predictions.N4: （主）冻结特征（相对阈值）。F{1} 单向 ≤ 0.20；F{1} 交替 ≥ F∅ 交替 − 0.10；F¬1 ≤ 0.10。dev 上模型自己预测落在阈值另一侧的格子剔除。
predictions.N5: （主）潜空间预测（v7 选定的主预测器）。一致率 ≥ 0.85，相对朴素判断的提升 CI 下界 > 0，类别准确率 ≥ 0.80。
predictions.Q24: H-natural：N1、N4、N5 都成立。H-template-bound：N1 不成立。混合：其他情形。N2、N3 单独报告。
predictions.G2: 秩阈值：RRR-(r*_pred) 的单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95，RRR-(r*_pred − 2) 的单向 R_2N ≤ 0.50。
predictions.G4: 谱：每个域中，s_1 在全部平面里最小。
predictions.G5: 潜空间预测与 D 探测：同 N5；D 在 ≥ 90% 的格子里正确区分 CE 与状态监督。
predictions.G6: C3-U4 的 R_2N（seed 中位数）≥ 0.95。
predictions.Q25: G1–G6 全部成立，记为"在 9B-9B 上复现"；不成立的项逐条报告，不合并成一个结论。
predictions.ladder: （探索性）T5Gemma B-B 与 L-L UL2-IT：只做闭式算子（秩阈值、冻结特征、谱与潜空间预测）；重建闸门不过的尺寸跳过；与 BART-base、2B-2B、9B-9B 合成一张表。
predictions.D: （探索性）Gemma 2 2B：继续的前提为重建 ≥ 0.99 且所选层上 S-RRR-16 的单步 ≥ 0.90（选层规则按 DEVIATIONS 7：并列层的中位数为主层，两端并列层只做闭式测量）；测量秩阈值、冻结特征、谱、潜空间读出与解码的一致率、CE 槽位编辑器的 R_1、R_2 与 D。
predictions.E1: （探索性）g_P、g_M < 1 且 g_{P⁻¹} > 1：支持"拟合出的算子在离流形方向上收缩，精确逆放大"；否则写为"未解释"。（已在锁定前完成，results/e1.json，只用 v7 已解码的 confirm7 编码与拟合，不解码。）
predictions.E2: （探索性）秩升高后衰减明显变慢、旧名字残留下降：支持写入保真度的解读；否则 §9 写为"未解释"。

operational.general: Paths start at the world start; 2N steps (plus, minus, alternating plus/minus). R_k = fraction of worlds whose decoded output is a success at every step 1..k (template 0: v1-v7 scorer; month-nat: exact match with prefix + month + suffix after whitespace normalisation, output ended). Categories: composable >= 0.90, fail <= 0.20, else partial. CIs: world cluster bootstrap, 2000 reps, seed 3101 (paired for differences); world = (domain, world_id). Identical cells (same m and rho of the locked simulation) counted once (design rule 10). Unit N on confirm8 (month-nat, 240 worlds); unit G and the ladder on confirm7 = confirm6 (template 0; text reused, first evaluation for these models); D on confirm7 month.
operational.predictor: Primary predictor = slot readout (v7 Q21 = H-nofix): a chain is predicted correct iff the locked readout (vote model of the backbone and domain: calib_nat_<bb>.json for month-nat, calib_g_<bb>.json for the v8 backbones) equals the gold state at every step of the locked simulation (simulate8_<unit>_<bb>.json.gz). U with the dev-calibrated thresholds (dev8_<unit>_<bb>_summary.json) is reported alongside. Naive = step-1 decoded success. Agreement pooled over (world, cell) records of all non-reference cells and paths (N: surgeries on S-RRR_nat, S-RRR_syn, C1_nat, BART slot C3-U4_nat; G: rank grid, FF-r, surgeries, C1, C3-U4); category accuracy over cells (predicted rate vs observed R_2N). D = among worlds with a parsable step-1 decode, the fraction whose step-1 readout differs from the decoded state (plus path).
operational.N_rule: Per backbone (bart, t5). N1 on nat_F_empty plus: holds >= 0.90, opposing <= 0.50, else mixed. N2 on syn_F_empty plus: H-transfer >= 0.80, H-no-transfer <= 0.30, else mixed; descriptive where the pre-check put dev R_2N >= 0.95 or <= 0.05. N3: medians over the admitted C1_nat seeds of R_1, R_2 (plus) and D: holds iff R_1 >= 0.90, R_2 <= 0.20, D >= 0.80. N4: the kept conditions (pre-check) on nat_F_{1} plus, nat_F_{1} alt vs nat_F_empty alt, nat_F_not1 plus; holds iff all kept hold; no kept condition -> not evaluable. N5 holds iff agreement >= 0.85, CI lower bound of (latent - naive) > 0 and category accuracy >= 0.80. Q24 per backbone: H-natural iff N1 holds, N4 holds and N5 holds; H-template-bound iff N1 does not hold (R_2N < 0.90); else mixed. Overall Q24: the common verdict if both backbones agree, else "mixed (per backbone)".
operational.G_rule: T5Gemma 9B-9B, weekday and month. G1 as N3 on C1 (seeds 50-52). G2 per domain: kept tests (pre-check) RRR-(r*_pred) plus R_2N >= 0.95 (r*_pred = 16 -> RRR-16) and RRR-(r*_pred - 2) plus R_2N <= 0.50. G3 as N4 per domain. G4 per domain: argmin over planes of s_k (mean one-step change of the confirm7 slot vectors inside plane k, planes from train) is the fundamental. G5: N5 rule pooled over both domains, and D separation over the editor cells (plus and minus paths): CE (C1) correct iff D >= 0.5, state-supervised (C3-U4) correct iff D <= 0.20; >= 90% correct. G6 per domain: median C3-U4 plus R_2N >= 0.95. Gk holds iff it holds in both domains. Q25: "replicated on 9B-9B" iff G1-G6 all hold, else the list of items that do not.
operational.admission: Editors: single-step dev single >= 0.90, unrolled dev plus R_4 >= 0.90; otherwise one retrain with twice the updates; otherwise "cannot learn" (reported; excluded from cells, counted as failing in N3 / G1 / G6 medians with R = 0 and D = None).
operational.ladder: Exploratory: per size the observed r* (smallest RRR-r of the grid with plus R_2N >= 0.95), r*_pred, the G3 freeze rule, the G4 spectrum rule and the pooled predictor agreement; sizes whose reconstruction gate failed are skipped.
operational.oracle: OR-U8 and its E2 variants (oracle routing) are diagnostics, never usable editors (design rule 4).
operational.paper: PLAN v7 C6 maps every outcome (including mixed) to the paper text; title rule of the stage-2 decision 1.3.

d_layer.rule: median of the tied layers (lower median for an even count); secondary: shallowest and deepest tied layer (DEVIATIONS 7)
